level_scaling.absorb_convention: native consumed shield points, not normalized prevented HP
level_scaling.factor_definition: native damage multiplier / victim health multiplier, before integer rounding

metrics.absorb_definition: healer-cast native SCHOOL_ABSORB points consumed on party before level scaling; not normalized prevented HP; applied/unconsumed shield capacity excluded
metrics.idle_definition: alive, in party combat, no active cast/channel or native GCD; equivalents use profile heal native hasted GCD
metrics.throughput_denominator: frozen intake recorded party-combat window; identical for all specs including early wipes
